verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents several operations that act on many items at once. Filtered sets of traces can be exported via the UI or API, automation rules and online evaluators run over filtered production traces, and an application can be executed across a whole dataset as an experiment with configurable concurrency. None of this is described as a general bulk-operations feature, such as multi-select edit, delete, tag or move. Missing for 10: explicit bulk select/act (edit, delete, tag, annotate) across many traces or examples, documented batch API endpoints, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
